title: Subject agency in the context of digital childhood: Possibilities for its emergence and suppression
abstract: Context and relevance. The main challenge posed by the digitalization of education, which involves the use of neural networks and artificial intelligence, is the need to restore the student’s own subject agency when solving educational tasks. Subject agency in activity is the most important condition for organizing the processes of developing the intellectual abilities of students and teachers. Objective. Determine the conditions under which AI is used by students as a means of solving tasks that ensure the initiation of subject agency in educational and project‑based activities. Hypothesis. The initiation of students' subject agency will be brought about by a special reconstruction of the digital systems used by master's students — search engines, AI systems — in order to transform them into a means of organizing their own activity for solving specially posed tasks. Such tasks, implemented in the process of students' learning, will make it impossible for master's students to directly handle digital system. Results The authors associate the solution of the research tasks formulated by them with a change in the forms of teaching in their specific work with master's students based on the creation of special educational tasks. The most important type of task is the task that initiates subject agency in educational work. Conclusions. The most important condition for restoring students' subject agency when using AI is the use of tasks in which students themselves identify the limitations of the answers offered by AI systems. In this case, the student is faced with the need to justify their new solution, which does not coincide with the answers offered by the AI.
